guideList: Press the 'Generate Numbers' button to randomly generate 6 lotto numbers.
If the generated numbers exactly match any past winning numbers, new numbers will be generated automatically.
Press the 'Save Numbers' button to save up to 5 games in local storage.
Saved numbers can be viewed in the 'Saved Numbers' section at the bottom of the screen.
Press the 'Save as PNG' button to download the saved numbers list as an image.

home.seoGuideTitle: LottoMate Statistical Number Generation & Analysis Guide
home.seoP1: LottoMate is a free automated lottery number generator that analyzes historical draw frequencies, odd/even ratios, and consecutive patterns to produce balanced combinations. Rather than pure random draws, it actively filters out past 1st-prize duplicate combinations for balanced statistical support number sets.
home.seoP2: While every lottery draw is an independent trial, utilizing well-distributed numbers based on statistical analysis maximizes anticipation and entertainment value. Explore LottoMate's comprehensive analytics tools alongside your ticket selections.
home.seoP3: ※ All number extractions and analytics on LottoMate are for statistical entertainment reference only and do not legally guarantee winning outcomes. Please play responsibly with small amounts.
